subject: Kickstart Handoff & Office-hours Roster + Replay Links
messages:
From: Emma Chandler <emma@acme-solutions.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickstart scheduling

Thanks for the quick note, Priyom — Victor and I took a look at the initial timeline and we have three priorities for the first two weeks: (1) model pinning + baseline perf checks, (2) integration of the streaming SDK for low-latency endpoints, and (3) access controls and audit logs for our SOC requirements.

We can do a 60-minute kickoff on July 20th at 9am PT or July 21st at 11am PT. Can you send the kickoff agenda and any pre-work so the engineering team knows what to expect? Also, will there be recordings for the drop-in office hours for folks who can't make the live sessions?

—Emma
Emma Chandler
Head of Platform Engineering, ACME Solutions
emma@acme-solutions.com
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Chandler <emma@acme-solutions.com>, Victor Huang <victor.huang@acme-solutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart Handoff & Office-hours Roster + Replay Links

Emma — thanks for the clear priorities. July 20th at 9am PT works for us; I’ve penciled the 60-minute kickoff on our side. Attached is a short Kickstart-Agenda (PDF) and an Implementation Checklist (xlsx) that maps the first two-week milestones to owners.

High level agenda (attached and pasted):
- 0–10m: Introductions & success criteria alignment (CS / Eng)
- 10–30m: Architecture review and integration plan (streaming SDK, auth)
- 30–45m: Baseline perf/latency expectations and test plan (model pinning)
- 45–60m: Action items, owners, and next office-hour slots

Office-hours cadence (weekly drop-ins for first 4 weeks):
- Tue 1pm–2pm PT 
- Thu 10am–11am PT
- Plus an end-of-week 30m sync for blockers (Fri 4pm PT)

We will record all sessions and post replays within 24 hours. Marissa (CC) will own the recording uploads and the public notes doc. David will lead the streaming SDK walkthrough and provide a short sample repo.

Pre-work for your eng team:
1) Share access to a QA project (IAM invite) so we can run baseline checks.
2) Confirm which model variant you want pinned for week 1.
3) List the IP allowlist ranges for VPC peering.

We’ll also attach an SOW draft for contract/coverage items; please flag any redlines. If this looks good I’ll send calendar invites for the kickoff + first two office-hours and include Zoom + recording links.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priyom Das
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Chandler <emma@acme-solutions.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart Handoff & Office-hours Roster + Replay Links

Looping in Monica to confirm recording hosting and shared notes workflow. Quick notes from our side:
- Recordings will be uploaded to the shared Drive folder (link below) and a summary note added to the HubSpot timeline under deal ACME-4521.
- Template for notes: Decisions, Action Items (owner + ETA), Blocking Issues, Follow-ups.
- David will publish a short sample repo for the streaming SDK by EOD Thursday (link included once live).

Attachments: SOW-draft-ACME.docx (for procurement review).

I’ll send calendar invites: Kickoff (20 Jul 9am PT) + first two office-hours (Tue / Thu) and include a recurring Zoom link. If Victor wants a separate technical deep-dive after the kickoff we can add a 90m session the following week.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — calendar invites received and both slots look good. Appreciate the checklist and the SOW draft; procurement will review and get back with any redlines by end of next week.

One quick ask: can recordings be posted with time-indexed highlights (0:00 architecture, 12:40 SDK walkthrough, 34:10 perf tests)? That would help our on-call folks skip to the right section.

—Victor
VP Engineering, ACME Solutions
victor.huang@acme-solutions.com
